findings.title: Sales & valuation views not loadable via the standard BAPI
findings.detail: BAPI_MATERIAL_SAVEDATA ignores TAXCLASSIFICATIONS (MG172) so the sales view can't be set from outside; the valuation view needs Material Ledger production-startup (CKMSTART), a transaction. Materials migrate as the client-level Basic view; these two views are a separate, post-basic step.
findings.action: ACCEPT: Basic view migrates now; sales/valuation views are a follow-on
